import numpy as np
y=dv_dt
fx={'1':np.ones_like(x),'x':x,'x2':x*x,'x3':x**3,'sinx':np.sin(x),'cosx':np.cos(x),'x4':x**4,'sinx*x':np.sin(x)*x,'cosx*x':np.cos(x)*x,'sin2x':np.sin(2*x),'cos2x':np.cos(2*x),'expx':np.exp(x)}
fv={'1':np.ones_like(v),'v':v,'v2':v*v,'v3':v**3,'1/v':1/v,'1/v2':1/v**2,'1/v3':1/v**3,'sqrtv':np.sqrt(v),'lnv':np.log(v)}

import numpy as np
def equation(t, x, v, params):
    p=params
    num=p[0]+p[1]*x+p[2]*np.sin(x)+p[3]*np.cos(x)+p[4]*v+p[5]/v+p[6]*x*v+p[7]*v*v
    den=1+p[8]*x*x+p[9]*x
    return num/den
